text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-san! Listen, listen~☆

One day while walking school grounds,
Smart Falcon ran up with huge smile.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You see, Sports Competition this time,
Falco gets to join Cheer Dance squad☆

"Inter-disciplinary Sports Competition." Held
twice yearly at Tracen Academy, big event
always drawing massive crowd.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
――Yep! Big Sports Competition with tons of
guests from outside school!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I dance in front of big crowd,
maybe lots will become Falco fans～, ehehe♪
But finding her again at dusk……

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go- Go-, fight oh-……
Let's go-, fight oh-……

About to call out,
noticed her speaking with another Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaa～…… cheer dance group would've been so nice, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dirt Aptitude Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah…… never expected
to end up flag-bearer……

text_block_list.name: Dirt Aptitude Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
"Dirt aptitude, flag-bearer aptitude"…… hear that
all the time. No way to stand out like this……

……Turns out instead of cheer squad dancers,
they got picked as flag-bearers.
While pondering words of encouragement―

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
……Decision made though, gotta give it our best!
Let's keep practicing for now☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Like this…… and this!
Then…… like this, and this!

Flag fluttered against twilight sky. Despite heavy
pole, swung flag with nimble precision. Understood
instantly why chosen.

After flag-waving practice ended,
approached once she was alone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew～, took lots of muscle……
So worn out……

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ―Wah! Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uuu～…… really wanted to show off
sparkly cute Falco dance routine though～……
choice_data_list: But, this might be a valuable experience

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
……Think so? Even waving flag,
think people will still go "She's amazing!"?

―Thus, tinged with bit of anxiety,
Inter-disciplinary Sports Competition began.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go- Go-! Fight oh-!
Let's go-! Fight oh-!

Smart Falcon stood alongside dazzling dancers
waving flag. Seizing center position,
wasted no time―

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go- Go-! Fight oh———!
Let's go-! Fight oh————!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Flag girl over there is incredible……!
Radiating pure passion!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, waving flag with insane energy……!
Like she's practically one with flag……!
……Or so thought, until―

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-! Dancers wild too! Look at that
pyramid stunt, totally next level!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, totally～! Look at those sparkling smiles!
So cool and cute, can't look away～♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haaa～…… "Flag form was awesome,
made dancers look super vivid!" someone told me……

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ……Dancers clearly stole spotlight after all.
choice_data_list: But they could tell you worked hard!
But they could tell you worked hard!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No one's gonna remember my face!
Only gonna remember giant flag～～……!

Effort doesn't guarantee instant results.
Road to top Umadol proved long journey……
